copy.introductionDescription: The Sulaiman AlRajhi University (SRU) Design System prioritizes developer productivity, combining university branding, bilingual Cairo typography, interactive components, native bidirectional support (LTR/RTL), and full WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance in a single, high-performance stylesheet.
copy.bootstrapIncludedDescription: All Bootstrap 5 components and tools are pre-integrated into sru-theme.css, eliminating boilerplate setup and ensuring full compatibility out of the box.
copy.directionStylesheetDescription: RTL support is included in sru-theme.css. Set dir="rtl" on the page's html element for right-to-left layout.
copy.optionalJavascriptDescription: Load the bundled JavaScript only when the page uses interactive Bootstrap components.
copy.accessibilityDescription: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant by default, providing keyboard navigation, screen reader support, high contrast, focus management, and reduced motion.
copy.bootstrapJavascriptUsage: Bootstrap JavaScript is optional. Load it only when you use interactive components such as modals, dropdowns, collapse, carousels, offcanvas panels, tooltips, popovers, or toasts. It already includes Popper.
copy.lucideCdnUsage: Add this CDN script once when the page uses Lucide icons. It loads the Lucide library.
copy.lucideMarkupUsage: Add the icon markup where you need an icon, then call `lucide.createIcons()` after those elements are in the page so Lucide can replace them with SVG icons.
copy.gettingStartedDescription: Quick-start integration guide: engineered to empower developers and AI coding assistants to build and deploy university platforms efficiently with zero friction:
copy.aiSkillDescription: Give an AI coding agent reusable instructions for building with the Sulaiman AlRajhi University Design System.
copy.chooseDirectionStylesheet: Load sru-theme.css and set the page direction to match the language.
copy.buildBootstrapLayouts: Build layouts effortlessly using ready-made components and utilities, with the system handling colors, typography, and accessibility standards automatically.
copy.loadInteractiveJavascript: Load the JavaScript bundle only when using interactive components such as modals, dropdowns, or tooltips.
copy.useGalleryExamples: Use the examples in this gallery as patterns, and check keyboard access and RTL layout when relevant.
copy.aiReviewWarning: AI agents make mistakes. You are responsible for comparing their output with the referenced gallery example and confirming it follows the design system before accepting it.
copy.aiSkillExplanation: This installable skill points an AI coding agent to the published SRU Design System guidance, the sole source of truth for UI decisions.
copy.aiSkillUsage: Save this content as SKILL.md in your AI coding tool's skills directory. The agent will fetch and read the linked guidance when needed; do not download that linked file into your project.
copy.installationDescription: Designed for maximum developer velocity: no complex package installations or manual file management required. Simply copy and paste the hosted snippets below to begin building immediately.
copy.darkThemeUsage: Set data-bs-theme="dark" on the html element to apply the dark theme across the page. Keep the existing lang and dir attributes for the page language and direction.
copy.darkThemePreviewDescription: Bootstrap components and utilities adapt to the selected theme.
copy.darkThemeRuntimeUsage: To switch themes while the page is open, update the same attribute with JavaScript. Set it to 'light' to return to the light theme.
copy.directionNote: For Arabic or another right-to-left page, set dir="rtl" on the html element and use {file}. RTL support is built in, and the stylesheet includes Bootstrap, so do not load another Bootstrap CSS file.
copy.heroDescription: The unified digital design system for Sulaiman AlRajhi University: an empowering ecosystem built to support developers and accelerate digital delivery, featuring unified visual identity, native bidirectional support (RTL / LTR), light & dark themes, and accessible components (WCAG 2.1 AA) for maximum impact with minimal effort.
copy.systemUsage: CSS includes pre-configured design tokens and components to minimize dev overhead. Add the JavaScript bundle for interactive components.
copy.foundationDescription: Bootstrap contextual colors use the university palette. Cairo is the shared font for Latin and Arabic content.
copy.typographyLead: Lead paragraph — a short introduction with more emphasis.
copy.formDescription: Form controls share focus, border, and validation styles. Labels remain visible and connected to their fields.
copy.accordionDescription: Accordions group related content into expandable sections. The first item starts open.
copy.accordionAccessibility: Use clear labels and preserve the built-in keyboard behavior.
copy.accordionServices: Group related services or topics so users can scan the available information and open only what they need.
copy.accordionNextSteps: Use the final panel for next steps, contact details, or a concise call to action.
copy.accordionStandardExample: Standard accordion — one panel open at a time
copy.accordionFlushExample: Flush accordion — useful inside bordered or compact layouts
copy.accordionFlushFirst: When should you use a flush accordion?
copy.accordionFlushFirstDescription: The flush variant removes the outer borders and rounded corners so the accordion can sit naturally inside another surface.
copy.accordionFlushSecondDescription: Add the accordion-flush class to the accordion container and keep the same accessible button and collapse attributes.
copy.accordionIndependentExample: Independent panels — multiple panels can stay open
copy.accordionIndependentFirstDescription: Omit data-bs-parent when each panel should keep its own open or closed state.
copy.accordionIndependentSecondDescription: This pattern works well for separate questions, settings, or content groups that users may need to compare.
copy.accordionColorExample: Color variants — use contextual Bootstrap utilities
copy.accordionColorPrimaryDescription: Use primary-subtle and primary-emphasis utilities to highlight general information while keeping the text readable.
copy.accordionColorSuccessDescription: Use success-subtle and success-emphasis for completed steps or positive service updates.
copy.accordionColorWarningDescription: Use warning-subtle and warning-emphasis to draw attention to information that needs review.
copy.cardSummary: A flexible surface for a summary, status, and next step.
copy.cardBorderTreatment: The card header and footer use the shared border treatment.
copy.cardContextualPalette: Contextual card backgrounds keep the same theme palette.
copy.cardServiceStatus: Combine a card body with a flush list group for compact service details.
copy.cardProgress: Use a progress bar when a user needs a clear view of their next step.
copy.cardHorizontal: A compact horizontal layout works well for a featured resource or identity panel.
copy.cardAction: Keep the primary action visible at the bottom of a flexible card body.
copy.carouselAccessibleCaption: A responsive slide with an accessible caption.
copy.carouselSharedComponents: Use the same components across university websites.
copy.carouselControls: Use the controls to move between slides.
copy.modalDescription: Use a modal for a focused task that needs a clear response.
copy.modalConfirmation: Your request is ready to be submitted. Do you want to continue?
copy.offcanvasDescription: Offcanvas panels work for navigation and secondary controls on smaller screens.
copy.secondaryNavigation: Keep secondary navigation easy to find.
copy.scrollspyInstruction: Scroll the panel to see the active navigation item update.
copy.scrollspyDescription: Scrollspy updates navigation based on the current scroll position. It is useful for long articles and settings pages.
copy.scrollspyHeadingHierarchy: Use a clear heading hierarchy so each target has a meaningful label.
copy.scrollspyActiveItem: The active item moves as this section enters the scroll area.
copy.toastDescription: Toasts show brief, non-blocking status feedback.
copy.helperDescription: Common helpers keep layouts responsive without adding one-off CSS.
copy.helperRatioDescription: Use ratio utilities to keep media at a consistent shape as the available width changes.
copy.helperStackDescription: Use stack utilities to add consistent spacing between items, and text-truncate to shorten overflow text.
copy.helperAccessibilityDescription: Use visually-hidden text to add context for assistive technology while keeping the visual label concise.
copy.helperActionFeedback: The button responds to clicks, and its hidden text adds context for assistive technology.
copy.helperFigureDescription: Use the placeholder utility to show an image example, then pair it with a figure caption and useful alternative text.
copy.tooltipDescription: Tooltips show a short label on hover or keyboard focus. Include the Bootstrap JavaScript bundle and initialize each tooltip after its element is in the page.
copy.tooltipInitialization: Initialize tooltip triggers with Bootstrap JavaScript:
copy.textTruncation: This line demonstrates text truncation when a long label does not fit in its container.
copy.brandLogoDescription: Choose the logo version that has enough contrast with its background. Keep the image at its original proportions.
copy.colorLogoUsage: Use the color logo on a light background so its colors stay clear.
copy.whiteLogoUsage: Use the white logo on a dark background. It may disappear on a light background.
copy.squareLogoIconUsage: Use the square logo icon for app icons and other square placements.
copy.faviconUsage: Use this 32 × 32 px image for browser tabs.
